title.ru: КОЛЫБЕЛЬ НЬЮТОНА -> JANUS/TRUMP: перенос инварианта, локальная композиция и контроль скрытого переходного взрыва
title.en: NEWTON'S CRADLE -> JANUS/TRUMP: invariant transfer, local composition, and hidden transient blow-up control

purpose.ru: Разобрать идеализированную механику колыбели Ньютона на переносимые в TRUMP операторы. Главная идея: через цепь может передаваться состояние/ограничение без переноса идентичности материального объекта; локальные взаимодействия композиционно переносят небольшой инвариантный пакет, а промежуточные узлы могут иметь временное внутреннее состояние и затем возвращаться к нейтральному состоянию. Для доказательной архитектуры обязательно считать не только вход и выход, но и максимальную сложность переходного состояния.

single_impulse_setup.initial_velocity: v_in on one end mass; others initially approximately at rest

dual_invariant_collapse.domain_condition: If all relevant outgoing velocities v_i are nonnegative, every pair product is nonnegative.
dual_invariant_collapse.consequence: All pair products must vanish; therefore at most one outgoing velocity is positive. Momentum then fixes that nonzero velocity to v_in.
dual_invariant_collapse.boundary: This is an idealized equal-mass elastic endpoint argument; it does not specify every detail of real finite-duration contact dynamics.

physics_layer.key_physics_firewall: ONE_BALL_OUT is not evidence that the incoming physical ball passed through the chain. What propagates is momentum/energy through local contact dynamics.

substrate_independent_mechanics.name: PAYLOAD_IDENTITY_NOT_OBJECT_IDENTITY
substrate_independent_mechanics.trump_translation: A reconstructed witness or residual constraint need not be the same syntactic object as the source; it must preserve exact claim-scoped semantics and validate against the source.

substrate_independent_mechanics.name: LOCAL_TO_GLOBAL_COMPOSITION
substrate_independent_mechanics.trump_translation: Do not require a global truth table when a chain of independently verifiable local relations composes exactly.

substrate_independent_mechanics.name: MATCHED_INTERFACE
substrate_independent_mechanics.trump_translation: Compatible boundary schemas/invariants allow clean certificate transport; representation mismatch should be treated as an explicit reflection/debt event.

substrate_independent_mechanics.name: TRANSIENT_STORAGE
substrate_independent_mechanics.trump_translation: A proof transform may create temporary resolvents/certificates and later collapse them. Endpoint compactness alone is insufficient; transient peak size and time must also be bounded.

substrate_independent_mechanics.name: DUAL_INVARIANT_CONSTRAINT
substrate_independent_mechanics.trump_translation: Search for small independently checked invariant sets that constrain residual semantics more strongly than one scalar invariant, but never assume a physics invariant has a Boolean analogue without proof.

substrate_independent_mechanics.name: LOSS_LEDGER
substrate_independent_mechanics.trump_translation: Any semantic weakening, certificate omission, approximation, or unverified cache must be recorded as loss/debt rather than silently treated as exact transfer.

substrate_independent_mechanics.name: REFLECTION
substrate_independent_mechanics.trump_translation: A failed interface or unresolved proof obligation may back-propagate to an earlier gate. This is a diagnostic signal, not permission to rewrite history.

substrate_independent_mechanics.name: DISPERSION
substrate_independent_mechanics.trump_translation: One source coupling that generates many residual clauses/resolvents is the proof-search analogue of dispersion; track branching and peak support explicitly.

substrate_independent_mechanics.name: ENDPOINT_RECONSTRUCTION
substrate_independent_mechanics.trump_translation: A compact final residual is not sufficient. The proof-carrying path must reconstruct and validate the original source claim.

substrate_independent_mechanics.name: PACKET_MULTIPLICITY
substrate_independent_mechanics.law: MULTIPLE_INPUT_IMPULSES_CAN PROPAGATE AS A MATCHED PACKET IN THE IDEALIZED CRADLE
substrate_independent_mechanics.trump_translation: Multiple independent obligations may remain factorized, as in BA4; the hard part begins when their interactions couple and generate new residual structure.

trump_newton_cradle_operator.name: PROOF_CARRYING_IMPULSE_CHAIN
trump_newton_cradle_operator.semantic_packet: K_j = claim-scoped residual relation/constraint carried at boundary j
trump_newton_cradle_operator.ideal_transport: K_{j+1} is semantically equivalent to a boundary-renamed K_j and is independently certified.

new_metric_family.motivation: Newton's cradle is compact at the endpoints but contains a finite transient compression wave. TRUMP must therefore measure the peak intermediate proof state, not only final artifact size.

metrics.R_peak: maximum intermediate resolvent/certificate/residual representation size during one composed transfer
metrics.B_peak: maximum branching/fan-out count of live proof obligations
metrics.W_peak: maximum temporary structural width encountered by the certified transform
metrics.semantic_leak: difference between required residual semantics and certified transported residual semantics
metrics.reflection_debt: proof obligations forced backward because an interface cannot discharge them locally

new_metric_family.critical_firewall: R_out = O(1) DOES NOT IMPLY CHEAP TRANSPORT. A polynomial claim fails if R_peak, B_peak, W_peak, or T_total is super-polynomial even when the final residual collapses back to one clause.

ba5_overlay.cradle_interpretation: Treat the single non-factorizing source clause as one semantic impulse packet entering a matched two-lane BA4 identity chain.
required_checks: K_{j+1} must be DERIVED, not manually added.
Projected allowed boundary states remain exactly {01,10,11}.
00 remains forbidden at every certified boundary.
One input coupling must not create an exponentially growing live resolvent set.
Track R_peak/B_peak/W_peak in addition to input/output sizes.
Reconstruction must validate the original BA5 CNF including K_0.

newton_style_success_signature.semantic_packet_count: 1 in -> 1 exact residual relation out per rung

two_invariant_search_heuristic_for_trump.research_question: Can a small set of independently verifiable semantic invariants force a much smaller residual family without enumerating all source assignments?
two_invariant_search_heuristic_for_trump.warning: This is a search heuristic. No general theorem says that SAT/CNF admits a momentum-energy analogue that yields polynomial solving.

cradle_failure_taxonomy.meaning: A required obligation cannot cross the current interface and returns to an earlier stage.
One compact source constraint splits into many live residual constraints.
Transport weakens or strengthens source semantics.
Input/output are compact but intermediate proof state becomes super-polynomial.
Adjacent relation schemas do not compose under the claimed invariant.
A proof incorrectly demands syntactic identity where only semantic/reconstructive identity is required, or vice versa.
Final compact output is accepted without independent source reconstruction/validation.

epistemic_firewall.rule: Use Newton's cradle to generate and organize proof obligations; only CNF-level certificates may promote TRUMP claims.
epistemic_firewall.real_world_boundary: Real Newton's cradles are lossy and involve finite-duration elastic waves; the idealized conservation model is a controlled abstraction.

recommended_handoff_delta.instruction: Append this as an overlay to the existing BA5 handoff. Do not replace BA5 preregistration requirements.
core_questions: Does one coupling behave like one impulse packet: one exact residual in -> one exact residual out?
What is the maximum transient resolvent/certificate state before it collapses?
Does any interface mismatch cause reflection/back-propagated proof debt?
Can two compact semantic invariants certify the residual without enumerating boundary vectors?
Is apparent endpoint simplicity hiding super-polynomial intermediate work?

semantic_seal.ru: Колыбель Ньютона учит Януса различать перенос состояния и перенос объекта: импульс может пройти через цепь, пока промежуточные носители лишь временно принимают нагрузку. Для TRUMP это означает: сохраняй точную семантику и обратный путь, компонуй локальные сертификаты, но измеряй пик переходной сложности. Один красивый выходной объект не оправдывает скрытый экспоненциальный шторм внутри.
semantic_seal.machine: OBJECT_IDENTITY != PAYLOAD_IDENTITY; LOCAL_TRANSFER + MATCHED_INTERFACES + EXACT_INVARIANTS + BOUNDED_TRANSIENT_STATE + SOURCE_RETURN => CERTIFIABLE_ENDPOINT_TRANSPORT
